rationale: C21 is the strongest candidate because both texts address federal employees serving under indefinite appointments, but the overlap consists mainly of standardized civil-service terminology and the directives appear to perform different functions: C21 establishes competitive-status and reemployment rights for Foreign Service personnel, while the child adds or revises an appointment category under an earlier order. C07 shares only the generic machinery of amending a prior executive order, and C03 merely concerns employee regulations in an unrelated travel-expense context. No displayed candidate supplies a sufficiently distinctive phrase, parallel operative sequence, or materially similar administrative mechanism to qualify as a drafting template.
